Name: Haley's Bakery - SVE
Author: inaiinai
Description:
[i]Simple visual patch for Haley's Bakery when used together with SVE.[/i]

[list]
[*]carried over SVE crop phases to correctly display in Pierre's garden behind the bakery[/*]
[*]separated the shed sprite from its tilesheet to prevent some misaligned pixels from being rendered[/*]
[*]added some decorations around the bakery to better match the SVE town square[/*]
[/list]

[quote][i]Kabulla updated their mod to work with SVE by changing the bakery's location starting from version [b]1.2.0.[/b]
Don't use my mod if you use the update. Have a look at the different placements and decide for yourself what you prefer. 
Keep in mind that you won't get the fix to the abandoned bakery sprite if you don't use my mod though.
You can still keep using this with the previous release just be sure to carefully read the installation instructions below :3
[/i][/quote]


[b]Installation[/b]

[list=1]
[*]Download Haley's Bakery [b]1.1.0[/b] from the old files section of the original mod[/*]
[*]Drop into your mod folder like usual
[/*]
[*]Replace the placeholder images (spring_zbakery.png, summer_zbakery.png, fall_zbakery.png, winter_zbakery.png) in /assets with the ones from the original mod or Haley Bakery Revised[/*]
[/list]



[i]
This is just the result of some personal edits I did for myself, I am mostly kept busy with modding skyrim these days.
I still might add some additional stuff at some point like more seasonal decoration or reworking the shed to better match elle's town buildings. I also didn't look into potential pathing issues NPC might have with the changed layout.
